030public class FractureJumpAbility extends BaseDurationAbility {
031
032        public static float CR_COST_MULT = 0.1f;
033        public static float FUEL_USE_MULT = 1f;
034        
035        
036        public static float NASCENT_JUMP_DIST = 50f;
037
038        protected boolean canUseToJumpToHyper() {
039                return true;
040        }
041        
042        protected boolean canUseToJumpToSystem() {
043                return true;
044        }
045        
046        protected Boolean primed = null;
047        protected NascentGravityWellAPI well = null;
048        protected EveryFrameScript ping = null;
049        
050        @Override
051        protected void activateImpl() {
052                //if (Global.getSector().isPaused()) return;
053                
054                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = getFleet();
055                if (fleet == null) return;
056                
057                if (fleet.isInHyperspaceTransition()) return;
058                
059                if (fleet.isInHyperspace() && canUseToJumpToSystem()) { 
060                        NascentGravityWellAPI well = getNearestWell(NASCENT_JUMP_DIST);
061                        if (well == null || well.getTarget() == null) return;
062                        
063                        this.well = well;
064                        ping = Global.getSector().addPing(fleet, Pings.TRANSVERSE_JUMP);
065                        primed = true;
066                } else if (!fleet.isInHyperspace() && canUseToJumpToHyper() &&
067                                fleet.getContainingLocation() instanceof StarSystemAPI) {
068                        ping = Global.getSector().addPing(fleet, Pings.TRANSVERSE_JUMP);
069                        primed = true;
070                } else {
071                        deactivate();
072                }
073        }
074
075        @Override
076        public void deactivate() {
077                if (ping != null) {
078                        Global.getSector().removeScript(ping);
079                        ping = null;
080                }
081                super.deactivate();
082        }
083
084        @Override
085        protected void applyEffect(float amount, float level) {
086                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = getFleet();
087                if (fleet == null) return;
088                
089                if (level > 0 && level < 1 && amount > 0) {
090                        float activateSeconds = getActivationDays() * Global.getSector().getClock().getSecondsPerDay();
091                        float speed = fleet.getVelocity().length();
092                        float acc = Math.max(speed, 200f)/activateSeconds + fleet.getAcceleration();
093                        float ds = acc * amount;
094                        if (ds > speed) ds = speed;
095                        Vector2f dv = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(Misc.getAngleInDegrees(fleet.getVelocity()));
096                        dv.scale(ds);
097                        fleet.setVelocity(fleet.getVelocity().x - dv.x, fleet.getVelocity().y - dv.y);
098                        return;
099                }
100                
101                if (level == 1 && primed != null) {
102                        float dist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
103                        if (well != null) {
104                                dist = Misc.getDistance(fleet, well) - well.getRadius() - fleet.getRadius();
105                        }
106                        if (well != null && fleet.isInHyperspace() && canUseToJumpToSystem() && dist < 500f) { 
107                                SectorEntityToken planet = well.getTarget();
108                                Vector2f loc = Misc.getPointAtRadius(planet.getLocation(), planet.getRadius() + 200f + fleet.getRadius());
109                                SectorEntityToken token = planet.getContainingLocation().createToken(loc.x, loc.y);
110                                
111                                JumpDestination dest = new JumpDestination(token, null);
112                                Global.getSector().doHyperspaceTransition(fleet, fleet, dest);
113                        } else if (!fleet.isInHyperspace() && canUseToJumpToHyper() &&
114                                        fleet.getContainingLocation() instanceof StarSystemAPI) {
115                                float crCostFleetMult = getCRCostMult(fleet);
116                                if (crCostFleetMult > 0) {
117                                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : getNonReadyShips()) {
118                                                if ((float) Math.random() < EmergencyBurnAbility.ACTIVATION_DAMAGE_PROB) {
119                                                        Misc.applyDamage(member, null, FleetMemberDamageLevel.LOW, false, null, null,
120                                                                        true, null, member.getShipName() + " suffers damage from Transverse Jump activation");
121                                                }
122                                        }
123                                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
124                                                float crLoss = member.getDeployCost() * CR_COST_MULT * crCostFleetMult;
125                                                member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-crLoss, "Transverse jump");
126                                        }
127                                        String key = "$makeTranverseJumpCostMoreCROnce";
128                                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(key);
129                                }
130                                
131                                float cost = computeFuelCost();
132                                fleet.getCargo().removeFuel(cost);
133                                
134                                
135                                StarSystemAPI system = (StarSystemAPI) fleet.getContainingLocation();
136                                
137                                Vector2f offset = Vector2f.sub(fleet.getLocation(), system.getCenter().getLocation(), new Vector2f());
138                                float maxInSystem = 20000f;
139                                float maxInHyper = 2000f;
140                                float f = offset.length() / maxInSystem;
141                                //if (f > 1) f = 1;
142                                if (f > 0.5f) f = 0.5f;
143                                
144                                float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegreesStrict(offset);
145                                
146                                Vector2f destOffset = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
147                                destOffset.scale(f * maxInHyper);
148                                
149                                Vector2f.add(system.getLocation(), destOffset, destOffset);
150                                SectorEntityToken token = Global.getSector().getHyperspace().createToken(destOffset.x, destOffset.y);
151                                
152                                JumpDestination dest = new JumpDestination(token, null);
153                                if (dest != null && dest.getDestination() != null && fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
154                                        JumpPointInteractionDialogPluginImpl.computeAndApplyJumpPay(
155                                                        fleet.getContainingLocation(), dest.getDestination().getContainingLocation());
156                                }
157                                Global.getSector().doHyperspaceTransition(fleet, fleet, dest);
158                        }
159                        
160                        primed = null;
161                        well = null;
162                }
163        }

183        @Override
184        public boolean isUsable() {
185                if (!super.isUsable()) return false;
186                if (getFleet() == null) return false;
187                
188                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = getFleet();
189                
190                if (fleet.isInHyperspaceTransition()) return false;
191                
192                if (TutorialMissionIntel.isTutorialInProgress()) return false;
193                
194                if (canUseToJumpToSystem() && fleet.isInHyperspace() && getNearestWell(NASCENT_JUMP_DIST) != null) {
195                        return true;
196                }
197                
198                if (canUseToJumpToHyper() && !fleet.isInHyperspace()) {
199                        //if (getNonReadyShips().isEmpty() &&
200                        if ((getFleet().isAIMode() || computeFuelCost() <= getFleet().getCargo().getFuel())) {
201                                return true;
202                        }
203                }
204                
205                return false;
206        }
207        
208        public NascentGravityWellAPI getNearestWell(float maxDist) {
209                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = getFleet();
210                if (fleet == null) return null;
211                if (!fleet.isInHyperspace()) return null;
212                
213                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
214                NascentGravityWellAPI closest = null;
215                List<Object> wells = fleet.getContainingLocation().getEntities(NascentGravityWellAPI.class);
216                for (Object o : wells) {
217                        NascentGravityWellAPI well = (NascentGravityWellAPI) o;
218                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(well.getLocation(), fleet.getLocation());
219                        dist -= well.getRadius() + fleet.getRadius();
220                        if (dist > maxDist) continue;
221                        if (dist < minDist) {
222                                minDist = dist;
223                                closest = well;
224                        }
225                }
226                return closest;
227        }

390        protected List<FleetMemberAPI> getNonReadyShips() {
391                List<FleetMemberAPI> result = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
392                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = getFleet();
393                if (fleet == null) return result;
394                
395                //float crCostFleetMult = fleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.EMERGENCY_BURN_CR_MULT);
396                //float crCostFleetMult = 1f;
397                float crCostFleetMult = getCRCostMult(fleet);
398                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
399                        //if (member.isMothballed()) continue;
400                        float crLoss = member.getDeployCost() * CR_COST_MULT * crCostFleetMult;
401                        if (Math.round(member.getRepairTracker().getCR() * 100) < Math.round(crLoss * 100)) {
402                                result.add(member);
403                        }
404                }
405                return result;
406        }
407
408        protected float computeFuelCost() {
409                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = getFleet();
410                if (fleet == null) return 0f;
411                
412                float cost = fleet.getLogistics().getFuelCostPerLightYear() * FUEL_USE_MULT;
413                return cost;
414        }
415        
416        protected float getCRCostMult(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
417                float crCostFleetMult = fleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.DIRECT_JUMP_CR_MULT);
418                String key = "$makeTranverseJumpCostMoreCROnce";
419                if (fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(key)) {
420                        crCostFleetMult = 20f;
421                }
422                
423                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
424                        crCostFleetMult *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_transverseJumpDamageMult");
425                }
426                
427                return crCostFleetMult;
428        }
429        
430        protected float computeSupplyCost() {
431                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = getFleet();
432                if (fleet == null) return 0f;
433                
434                //float crCostFleetMult = fleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.EMERGENCY_BURN_CR_MULT);
435                //float crCostFleetMult = 1f;
436                float crCostFleetMult = getCRCostMult(fleet);
437                
438                float cost = 0f;
439                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
440                        cost += member.getDeploymentCostSupplies() * CR_COST_MULT * crCostFleetMult;
441                }
442                return cost;
443        }

447        protected boolean showAlarm() {
448                if (getFleet() != null && getFleet().isInHyperspace()) return false;
449                return !getNonReadyShips().isEmpty() && !isOnCooldown() && !isActiveOrInProgress() && isUsable();
450        }
